video_caption: The video opens with a title card displaying "Section 3: Preparing the Patient" and "UNIT III Patient Positioning" (UNIT III Patient Positioning) against a blurred blue background showing a patient on an operating table. This transitions to another title card reading "Physiology and Anatomical Considerations" (Physiology and Anatomical Considerations) over the same blurred background. A woman with dark hair, wearing a white lab coat over blue scrubs and a necklace, then appears, speaking directly to the camera in what looks like a medical or classroom setting, with medical equipment and anatomical models visible in the background. She uses hand gestures as she speaks. The scene then shifts to an operating room where a patient, wearing a light blue gown and a surgical cap, lies supine on an operating table. Three medical professionals, dressed in blue scrubs, surgical caps, and masks, are carefully positioning the patient. One medical professional, standing at the patient's head, adjusts their arm, which is resting on a padded arm support. Another, positioned at the patient's torso, adjusts a wide black strap placed across the patient's hips. The third professional, at the patient's feet, adjusts a pillow placed under the patient's lower legs. The operating table then slowly begins to tilt and rotate, illustrating the process of patient positioning. The medical professionals observe the patient as the table continues to move, with one holding a remote control. The patient is shown with arms extended comfortably on armrests and legs straight, supported by pillows. The scene transitions to a black screen, then displays a final title card, "Supine Position" (Supine Position), again over a blurred image of a patient on an operating table.

A woman in a white lab coat and blue scrubs, with short, dark hair and a pearl necklace, is speaking directly to the camera with an open mouth, presumably explaining medical procedures. She is standing in what appears to be a medical or laboratory setting, with a blue cabinet visible to her left and some indistinct medical equipment to her right against a plain light gray wall.

The video opens in an operating room, showing a patient lying supine on an operating table in the Trendelenburg position (head lower than feet). A person in blue scrubs and a face mask stands to the right, operating the table with a remote control. The patient is wearing a light green gown, with their torso secured by a wide black strap, and their arms extended on armrests. Blue foam blocks are placed under their feet to provide support. An overhead shot provides a full view of the patient in this position, followed by a close-up on the patient's feet. The scene then cuts to a woman with dark hair, wearing a white lab coat over blue scrubs, speaking directly to the camera. Afterward, the video returns to the operating room scene, now with a blue-purple tint, and the patient is positioned in the Reverse Trendelenburg position (head higher than feet). A purple text bar appears at the bottom, stating "Reverse Trendelenburg Position". The segment concludes with a close-up of a person's gloved hands pressing buttons on a black remote control.

The video begins in a brightly lit operating room, showing a female patient wearing a light blue surgical gown and a blue hair net, lying supine on a medical operating table. Her arms are extended and secured to armrests, and her feet rest on blue, textured pads, with a black strap across her hips for stability. The operating table is visibly tilted in a Trendelenburg position, with her head lower than her feet, which an off-screen narrator explains is to provide unobstructed access to the upper peritoneal cavity and lower esophagus for the surgeon by allowing gravity to move internal organs. The camera then switches to an overhead view of the patient in the same tilted position, before cutting to a black screen, then a blurred, blue-tinted image with the text "Lithotomy Position" in a magenta bar at the bottom. The video concludes with a clear shot of a professional-looking woman with dark hair, dressed in a white lab coat over blue scrubs, standing and speaking directly to the camera in what appears to be a medical training room, with equipment and anatomical models visible in the background.

A woman with dark hair, wearing a white lab coat over blue scrubs, stands in a medical setting, speaking directly to the camera and gesturing with her hands. Behind her are medical monitors and anatomical models of a heart and a head/neck. The scene then transitions to an overhead view of a patient lying on a gurney, wearing a light green gown and a blue surgical cap. Her arms are secured to armrests, and a black strap crosses her abdomen. Two medical staff members, both in blue scrubs, surgical masks, and hair coverings (one blue, one patterned), carefully lift the patient's legs. They work in unison, slowly raising the patient's legs, which are flexed at the knees and hips, and gently placing them into black, padded stirrups that are covered with white cloths, ensuring the feet are supported and protected. The two staff members continue to adjust the legs and wrap the patient's feet and lower calves with white towels.

The video opens with a top-down view of a patient lying on an operating table in a lithotomy position, with their legs elevated and supported by stirrups. Two medical professionals, dressed in blue scrubs, masks, and hairnets, are assisting the patient. One professional is adjusting the patient's left leg in the stirrup, while another is near the patient's head. The patient is wearing a light green gown and a blue hairnet, with their arms strapped to arm supports at their sides. A side view then shows one medical professional carefully placing white padding around the patient's lower legs in the stirrups, demonstrating care and respect for the patient's dignity by covering the perineal area with a white sheet during positioning. Another medical professional then uses a remote control to slowly lower the stirrups, bringing the patient's legs down to a more horizontal position on the operating table, with the other professional supporting the legs throughout the movement. The stirrups are then completely removed, and the medical professionals carefully guide the patient's legs from the stirrup supports to lie flat on the table, ensuring they are properly supported by padding. The scene then transitions to a blue overlay with the text "Sitting (Fowler) Position" displayed in white text on a purple bar, suggesting a shift to a new topic. The video ends with a close-up of a person's gloved hands operating a remote control with multiple buttons, with medical equipment visible in the background, before fading to black.

The video opens with a patient wearing a light green gown and a blue surgical cap, lying supine on an operating table. Two medical professionals in blue scrubs and masks are present; one on the right is operating a remote control to adjust the table, raising the patient's upper body and head into a semi-Fowler position. The patient's arms are extended outwards and supported on armrests, and their lower body is secured by straps. Medical equipment, including an IV pole and monitors, is visible in the background of the operating room. A purple bar then displays the text "Lateral (Sims) Position," indicating the next patient positioning. Following this, the scene transitions to the patient now lying in a lateral (Sims) position on the operating table, with their side resting on the table. Three medical professionals in blue scrubs and masks are involved in positioning. One professional at the patient's left is carefully placing pillows between the patient's bent legs and securing them with a strap, while another professional on the right is adjusting the patient's extended upper arm onto a pillow for support. The table remains flat, and the patient's back is partially visible to the camera. Another purple bar then appears with the text "Prone Position," signaling a further change in patient orientation. The video concludes with the patient shown in the prone position, lying face down on the operating table. Two medical professionals, again in blue scrubs and masks, are actively positioning them; the professional on the left is placing a pillow under the patient's lower legs, slightly elevating them, while the professional on the right attends to the patient's head, which rests on a specialized head support, and adjusts the arms, which are extended forward on armrests. Straps are seen securing the patient around the hip area.

The video opens in an operating room, showing two medical professionals in blue scrubs, surgical caps, masks, and gloves, carefully positioning a patient lying prone on an operating table. The patient wears a light blue gown, and a white rolled pillow is placed under their chest. The medical professional at the patient's feet adjusts their ankles, while the other at the mid-section adjusts a black strap around the patient's hips. The scene transitions to a woman in a white lab coat over blue scrubs, standing in a medical office or teaching room, gesturing with her hands as she explains. Behind her are anatomical models of a heart and a head/neck, along with medical equipment. The video then returns to the operating room, showing a closer view of the patient's upper body resting on the white rolled pillow, with arms extended onto padded arm supports. After a brief black screen, a title card appears with a blue filter over the operating room scene, displaying "Jackknife or Kraske Position" in white text on a purple bar at the bottom, indicating the subject of the next segment. The video then shows a wider, top-down view of the operating room with three medical professionals. The two previously seen continue to position the patient, while a third medical professional, an older man in similar attire, uses a remote control to articulate the operating table. The table's foot section is lowered, creating a "jackknife" position with the patient's legs flexed downwards, resting on blue pads, suitable for anorectal surgery, as narrated.
